backend/main.mo: Defines the backend canister’s state, data types, and authorization mixin, storing confessions, threads, resources, events, user settings, and moderation actions.
feature_evidence.json: Lists implemented features with associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten summaries of many frontend files for reference in build planning.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS variables and theme styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures the app’s main router, layout, and all route definitions including matches, swipe matching, and chat.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI component showing an access denied message with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAdmi: Route guard requiring admin authentication, showing login or denial screens when appropriate.
frontend/src/components/confessions/Conf: Renders a confession card with timestamp and a report button that opens a report dialog.
frontend/src/components/layout/BottomNav: Displays a fixed bottom navigation bar with tabs and highlights the active route.
frontend/src/components/layout/MobileSca: Provides a mobile layout with a header, scrollable content area, and bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/moderation/Repor: Modal dialog for submitting content reports with reason selection and optional notes.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Quick: Implements a multi-step onboarding tour with navigation controls and completion handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useComplianceGate.ts: Manages local-storage-backed compliance acceptance state with accept and reset helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, stored identities, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls in React Query hooks for fetching and mutating confessions, profiles, and moderation actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQuickTour.ts: Tracks completion of the quick tour using local storage with functions to complete or reset it.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for light and dark themes, applying global border, background, and text styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/chat/EncryptedChatEnt: Shows a placeholder encrypted chat entry screen with match info and notice that messaging is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/confessions/Confessio: Loads and displays approved confessions with loading and error states and navigation to create new posts.
frontend/src/pages/confessions/NewConfes: Allows users to write and submit anonymous confessions with validation and moderator review notice.
frontend/src/pages/discussions/Discussio: Displays discussion categories and a placeholder state encouraging users to start new discussion rooms.
frontend/src/pages/discussions/NewThread: Form for creating a new discussion thread with title, category, and content, ending in a placeholder submit action.
frontend/src/pages/discussions/ThreadDet: Placeholder page showing thread details with a back button.
frontend/src/pages/events/EventDetail.ts: Placeholder event detail page with navigation back to the events list.
frontend/src/pages/events/Events.tsx: Displays upcoming events with filtering and an admin-only create button, currently showing an empty state.
frontend/src/pages/events/NewEvent.tsx: Admin-only form for creating new events with fields for title, type, location, and description.
frontend/src/pages/HelpSupport.tsx: Displays help resources, crisis info, and community guidelines using cards and accordions.
frontend/src/pages/matches/Matches.tsx: Shows user matches, handles auth states, loading, and errors, and links to the swipe matching flow.
frontend/src/pages/matches/SwipeMatching: Swipe-based matching interface that fetches candidates, records likes/dislikes, and handles match notifications.
frontend/src/pages/moderation/ModeratorD: Admin moderation dashboard for reviewing reported confessions and updating their status with optional notes.
frontend/src/pages/OnboardingGate.tsx: Shows onboarding requirements with checkboxes for age and guideline confirmation before granting access.
frontend/src/pages/profile/Profile.tsx: React profile page that loads, edits, and saves a user's private profile, handling authentication, form state, and loading UI.
frontend/src/pages/resources/Resources.t: UI for browsing mental‑health resources with search and category filters, rendering cards that link to external contacts.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Provides user settings for privacy and notifications, saving profile changes and offering quick tour reset.
frontend/src/utils/privacy.ts: Utility helpers for anonymous labels, timestamp formatting, and redacting principal strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and included plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current architecture, features, requirements, and known issues for the MVP.
